facts.fact: Heirs Technologies, citing Data Center Map, says Nigeria has 16 active data centres in 2025, with Lagos hubs including Equinix/MainOne and Rack Centre.
facts.system: Nigerian data centres (Data Center Map count)

facts.fact: The report lists Nigeria's Tier III-certified facilities by operator as Rack Centre, Equinix/MainOne, Digital Realty, NTT Global, MTN, Galaxy Backbone, OADC and ipNX Nigeria; it names operators, not individual facilities, and gives no certification dates or certifying body, so the date is the report's published month.

systems.system: Huawei Cloud (Lagos, per Data Center Map)

note: Cloud: Lagos listed as having AWS and Huawei Cloud as cloud-infrastructure providers, not stated as live cloud regions, so no cloud fact.
